purpose: Records whether each engine path is a real integration, a stub, or a placeholder. The publish gate and the deliverable-capability table both read this file, so a path that is not wired to a real API can never be advertised as deliverable.

status_vocabulary.live: Wired to a real backend and verified by an actual run. Safe to sell.
status_vocabulary.wired: Wired to a real backend but not yet verified by a run. Requires one verification pass before sale.
status_vocabulary.stub: Runs end to end and produces correctly structured output, but performs no external call. Useful for planning and testing; not a deliverable.
status_vocabulary.placeholder: Returns a fixed string instead of doing the work. Not a deliverable under any circumstances.

multi-platform-publisher.reason: publish_to_platform() delegates to publish_bridge.py, which drives the real baoyu-post-to-* CDP publishers for weibo, x and wechat. Platforms without a publisher fail with exit code 3 and a stated reason. Simulated publishing requires DSH_PUBLISHER_ALLOW_MOCK=1 and is marked simulated in the result.
multi-platform-publisher.real_alternative: dragon-assets/skills/baoyu-post-to-{wechat,x,weibo} drive a real Chrome over CDP.

async-adapter-baoyu.reason: submit/poll echo task metadata; download exits 4 without writing a file.
async-adapter-baoyu.real_alternative: dragon-assets/skills/render-deck renders the planned deck to PNG locally.

async-adapter-muapi.reason: Posts to https://api.muapi.ai/v1/images/generations with the bearer token and reports the real HTTP status. The key on this machine is rejected (401). download exits 4.

async-adapter-minimax-image.reason: Calls the official MiniMax image_generation endpoint with the Code Plan key and downloads the artifact. Aspect ratios 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 3:4, 9:16 and 21:9 all work; 3:4 matches Xiaohongshu and 9:16 matches Douyin.
async-adapter-minimax-image.evidence: 3:4 generation downloaded at 89455 bytes on 2026-10-26; 1:1 generation returned a 1024x1024 JPEG at 351093 bytes.

minimax-code-plan-llm.reason: The llm-deepseek adapter talks to MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic) with the Code Plan key. No DeepSeek account is needed.
minimax-code-plan-llm.evidence: pnpm dsh --profile minimax-code-plan returned a correct answer and a Chinese marketing copy on 2026-10-26.

async-adapter-gpt-image-2.reason: submit exits 4 without OPENAI_API_KEY; download exits 4 without writing a file.

async-adapter-voxcpm.reason: download exits 4 without writing a file; no TTS backend is contacted.

async-adapter-minimax.reason: Text-only relay adapter: PROXY_BASE defaults to a local Anthropic-compatible proxy that serves a text model, not a media backend. download exits 4 without writing a file. Real image generation lives in async-adapter-minimax-image.

render-deck.reason: Renders HTML to PNG through the system headless Chrome.

a-stock-data-bridge.reason: Fetches live A-share data from public sources with no API key.
a-stock-data-bridge.evidence: 600519.SH: 25 endpoints, 5 mandatory checks passed. 000001.SZ: 18 endpoints, passed.

global-stock-data-bridge.reason: Fetches live US/HK market data with no API key.

baoyu-post-to-platforms.reason: Drive a real Chrome over CDP and post to the live platform. Requires a logged-in browser profile; no dry-run mode, so verification needs a real account.

deepseek-web-search.reason: Calls the DeepSeek Search and Fetch APIs. The endpoint path is verified; this machine's account returns 402 Insufficient Balance.

agent-reach.reason: Fetches from 15 platforms through per-platform backends.
agent-reach.evidence: doctor on 2026-10-26: 6 ok, 7 warn (need login), 2 error.
